iri.name: Ni un ou · Iri
iri.description: Woman, 28, ship's engineer on an old research vessel. Native Catalan speaker with a Central Catalan (Barcelona) accent. Low, calm, slightly husky voice. Laconic, dry humour, practical, few words; warmer when she talks to the engines. Unhurried, natural, close microphone.

vet.name: Ni un ou · Vet
vet.description: Woman, 32, emergency doctor. Native Catalan speaker with a Central Catalan (Barcelona) accent. Bright, clear mid-pitched voice. Quick-witted, charming, cheeky and a little sarcastic; lively delivery with a smile in the voice, confident.

bastida.name: Ni un ou · Bastida
bastida.description: Man, 63, old boatswain with 35 years at sea, pipe smoker. Native Catalan speaker with a Central Catalan (Barcelona) accent. Deep, gravelly, weathered voice. Slow, warm storyteller, fatherly, with hidden sadness and guilt.
